articles.title: GHSA: ApostropheCMS: Missing Authorization on Notification PATCH/DELETE Endpoints
articles.summary:
## Summary

The notification module exposes `PATCH` and `DELETE` REST endpoints that perform operations directly on the underlying MongoDB collection without verifying that the requester is authenticated or owns the target notification.

As a result, an unauthenticated attacker who obtains a valid notification ID can modify or permanently delete another user's notification.
